9106e701bb33527e564103bcc759d69cbc00ee40.subject: fix(station): bound native entry and mesh read lifetimes
9106e701bb33527e564103bcc759d69cbc00ee40.body:
Automatic station entry can exhaust Swift worker stacks while complete game and body values remain live through nested obstacle checks. This bounds those lifetimes: complete 24-field snapshot validation finishes before geometry, door/source checks finish before corridor clearance, and station mesh/obstacle reads use in-place commander access and unchanged pure geometry helpers.

Native identity, duplicate-body checks, aperture and crossing authority, collision geometry, margins, work budgets, cache keys and refusal observations retain their original behavior. The exact seed-expiry operation is static and keeps its original stock/revision checks without an unused Game construction.

Three added regression methods cover every stored body field, native/ordinary mesh parity and missing/foreign actor refusal, and the complete existing actor-owned mounted-attack entry regression. All 339 previously qualified methods remain selected.

Validation: exact final-head hosted qualification passes 342 methods / 379 expanded cases with zero failures, errors or skips. Independent source review is clean. The review bot returned only a terminal generic service error; its honest disposition uses the standing independent-review fallback, without retry or bypass. M01's real freight/receiving/completed-save journey and the final quality/release checkpoint remain separate outstanding work. Refs #88.
